en: Midnight Wu Songs: Spring Song by Li Bai

wg.en: Midnight Wu Songs (a type of folk song)

t: 秦地羅敷女，采桑綠水邊。
c: 秦地罗敷女，采桑绿水边。
p: Qín dì Luó Fū nǚ, cǎi sāng lǜ shuǐ biān.
z: ㄑㄧㄣˊ ㄉㄧˋ ㄌㄨㄛˊ ㄈㄨ ㄋㄩˇ，ㄘㄞˇ ㄙㄤ ㄌㄩˋ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄅㄧㄢ。
en: The girl Luofu from the land of Qin gathers mulberries by the green water.

wg.en: Qin land (referring to the Chang'an area)

t: 素手青條上，紅妝白日鮮。
c: 素手青条上，红妆白日鲜。
p: Sù shǒu qīng tiáo shàng, hóng zhuāng bái rì xiān.
z: ㄙㄨˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄊㄧㄠˊ ㄕㄤˋ，ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄓㄨㄤ ㄅㄞˊ ㄖˋ ㄒㄧㄢ。
en: Her white hands rest upon the green branches; her red makeup shines bright in the sunlight.

t: 蠶飢妾欲去，五馬莫留連。
c: 蚕饥妾欲去，五马莫留连。
p: Cán jī qiè yù qù, wǔ mǎ mò liú lián.
z: ㄘㄢˊ ㄐㄧ ㄑㄧㄝˋ ㄩˋ ㄑㄩˋ，ㄨˇ ㄇㄚˇ ㄇㄛˋ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄌㄧㄢˊ。
en: The silkworms are hungry and I must leave; do not let your five-horse carriage linger here.

wg.en: five horses (referring to a high official's carriage)
